items.title: Start the console with npx wingfoil-ui and have the browser open on it
items.story: As Alex, I want to start the console with `npx wingfoil-ui` and have the browser open on it, so that I use it without installing anything beyond Node 22

acceptance_criteria.title: Start the console with npx
steps: Given Node.js 22.12 is installed and no package "wingfoil-ui" is installed globally
When I run "npx wingfoil-ui"
Then the command prints a URL starting with "http://127.0.0.1:"
And the default browser opens that URL
And the page shows the project switcher with the action "Add project…"

acceptance_criteria.title: Refuse to start on an unsupported Node.js version
steps: Given Node.js 20.11 is the active Node.js version
When I run "npx wingfoil-ui"
Then the command exits with a non-zero status
And it prints "WingFoil UI needs Node.js 22.12 or later (found 20.11)"
And no port is opened

acceptance_criteria.title: Start without opening a browser when none is available
steps: Given no default browser is configured on the machine
When I run "npx wingfoil-ui"
Then the command prints the URL to open
And the server keeps running

items.title: The console to accept only my browser session, through a token given at launch
items.story: As a member, I want the console to accept only my browser session, through a token given at launch, so that nobody else on my machine drives my projects through it

acceptance_criteria.title: Serve the browser session opened with the token
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I open the printed URL in the browser
Then the project switcher lists the kanban fixture
And the address bar no longer shows the token

acceptance_criteria.title: Issue a new token at every start
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
Given the token printed at the previous start
When I stop the console, start it again and send a request with the previous token
Then the response status is 401

items.title: Requests from other machines refused (loopback only)
items.story: As a member, I want requests from other machines refused (loopback only), so that nobody on my network reads or acts on my projects

acceptance_criteria.title: Listen on the loopback interface only
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I list the server's listening sockets
Then every listening address is 127.0.0.1 or ::1

acceptance_criteria.title: Refuse a connection on the machine's network address
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
Given the machine has the network address 192.0.2.10
When I send a request with the session token to "http://192.0.2.10:<port>/"
Then the connection is refused

items.title: Requests from another web page (foreign Origin or Host, DNS rebinding) or without the session token refused, writes …
items.story: As a member, I want requests from another web page (foreign Origin or Host, DNS rebinding) or without the session token refused, writes included, so that a malicious site cannot run my CLI

acceptance_criteria.title: Refuse requests without a valid session
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I send a <method> request to the project API <condition>
Then the response status is <status>
And the server runs no `wingfoil` or `git` process for it
| method | condition                                         | status
| GET    | without the session token                         | 401
| POST   | without the session token                         | 401
| GET    | with the token and the Origin "https://evil.test" | 403
| POST   | with the token and the Origin "https://evil.test" | 403

acceptance_criteria.title: Refuse a DNS-rebinding request
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I send a GET request with the session token and the Host header "evil.test:<port>"
Then the response status is 403

acceptance_criteria.title: Accept a request with the token from the console's own origin
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I send a GET request with the session token, the Origin "http://127.0.0.1:<port>" and the Host "127.0.0.1:<port>"
Then the response status is 200

And the kanban fixture is added
Given the kanban fixture lives at "/home/test/projects/kanban"
When I open the kanban fixture and its Memory list
Then no URL requested by the page contains "/home/test" or "projects/kanban"

acceptance_criteria.title: Refuse a project id that is not in the list
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I send a GET request with the session token for the project id "../../etc"
Then the response status is 404

items.title: `ui.yaml`: the UI's only file
items.description: `.wingfoil/ui.yaml` holds the UI's conventions (`version`, `taxonomy`, `progress`, `artifacts`) and nothing else — no permissions (they are WingFoil's, L6), no secrets. It has a JSON schema in `contracts/`. Without it, or when it fails the schema, the UI uses inferred defaults and warns. A preset (Kanban, Scrum, `sw-life-cycle`) is offered only when the file does not exist, refused when it maps a type the project does not declare, and validated before writing. `progress.scope` declares a type only; the current element is derived.

items.title: Git interface
items.description: The server runs only these git operations: read (`rev-parse`, `status --porcelain`, `log`, `rev-list --count`, `config user.email`, `remote`), `clone` (adding a remote project, into a new empty folder), `fetch`, `pull --ff-only`, `push`, and `add -- .wingfoil/ui.yaml` + `commit -- .wingfoil/ui.yaml` for presets. It never merges, rebases, resets, stashes or checks out. Git's error message is shown verbatim on failure. Memory events (Timeline, Recent activity) are parsed from `wf(…)` subjects; `add` and `submit` subjects carry no transition, so a submit's `from → to` is read from the element file's `status` before and after the commit (`git log -p` on the element file, or `memory history <id>` when its output carries the states — to be fixed by the Memory-event tech-spec).
items.fit_criterion: [percentage] 100 % of the git processes started during the e2e suite use a subcommand of the allowed list (process audit).

items.fit_criterion: [boolean] With one page open and no change for 60 s, the server starts 0 CLI processes; after a change the page updates without a reload (REQ-PERF-03).

items.title: Loopback only
items.description: The server listens on 127.0.0.1 and ::1 only.
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] Every listening socket of the server process is bound to a loopback address; a connection to the machine's network address is refused.

acceptance_criteria.title: Listen on the loopback interface only
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I list the server's listening sockets
Then every listening address is 127.0.0.1 or ::1

acceptance_criteria.title: Refuse a connection on the machine's network address
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
Given the machine has the network address 192.0.2.10
When I send a request with the session token to "http://192.0.2.10:<port>/"
Then the connection is refused

items.title: Session token
items.description: Each start issues a new random session token (≥ 128 bits), given in the printed URL, removed from the address bar after the first load, and required on every HTTP request and event stream; it is never written to logs or disk.
items.fit_criterion: [percentage] 100 % of requests without the current token (or with a previous start's) get HTTP 401 and start 0 processes; the token appears in 0 log lines.

acceptance_criteria.title: Serve the browser session opened with the token
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added
When I open the printed URL in the browser
Then the project switcher lists the kanban fixture
And the address bar no longer shows the token

acceptance_criteria.title: Issue a new token at every start
steps: Given the console has been started with "npx wingfoil-ui" and printed its URL with the session token
And the kanban fixture is added

When I stop the console, start it again and send a request with the previous token
Then the response status is 401

items.fit_criterion: [percentage] 100 % of requests with a foreign Origin or Host get HTTP 403 and start 0 processes, whatever the method.

items.title: Opaque project ids
items.description: URLs and API paths identify projects by an opaque id issued by the server; no file-system path appears in a URL; an unknown id gets HTTP 404.
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] Across the e2e suite, 0 requested URLs contain a fixture's absolute path; a request for the id `../../etc` gets 404.

items.title: No shell
items.description: CLI and git processes are started with `execFile` and argument arrays; user input (titles, reasons, paths, URLs) is passed as arguments, never interpolated into a command line.
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] A lint rule finds 0 uses of `exec`, `execSync` or `shell: true` in `server/`; a decision-log titled `x"; touch /tmp/pwned; "` is created with that literal title and `/tmp/pwned` does not exist.

items.title: Confinement to the repository
items.description: Files, documents and links resolve paths with `realpath` and serve only paths inside the project repository; `..` and symlinks that escape it are refused or marked.
items.fit_criterion: [percentage] 100 % of the path-traversal cases of the security suite (`..`, encoded `..`, absolute paths, escaping symlinks) return 404 or the "outside the repository" marker with 0 bytes of the target.
